hookText: Ruby2ßhell: pre-authentication RCE on stock Rails

beats.say: Veria Labs disclosed a heap overflow in Ruby's case conversion for single-byte encodings, reachable from default Rails and Sinatra apps; Ruby 3.3.14, 3.4.13 and 4.0.10 fix it.
The output buffer is the input length plus 20 bytes, so 21 ß characters overflow it by one byte.
The bug dates back to Ruby 2.4.0 and is reached by,, and; UTF-8 strings are not affected. The same loop is in several ISO-8859 and Windows-125x encodings and has been there since Ruby 2.4.0.
